name: ai_content_automation_tool
description: An open-source AI-powered tool that automates content creation and publishing by writing scripts, generating voiceovers, creating videos, and uploading them automatically to support hands-free YouTube channel growth.

inputs.name: script_topic
inputs.description: Topic or keyword to generate the video script about.

inputs.name: voiceover_settings
inputs.description: Parameters for voiceover generation such as language, voice type, and speed.

inputs.name: video_assets
inputs.description: Images, clips, or other media assets to be included or referenced in video creation (optional).

inputs.name: upload_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication details required to upload the video automatically to YouTube.

outputs.name: generated_script
outputs.description: AI-generated script text for the video.

outputs.name: voiceover_audio
outputs.description: Synthesized voiceover audio file based on the generated script.

outputs.name: final_video
outputs.description: Created video file combining the script, voiceover, and visuals.

outputs.name: upload_status
outputs.description: Confirmation or error message regarding the automatic upload of the video to YouTube.

patterns: AI script generation from topic keywords
Automated video assembly from audio, script, and media assets
Automated content upload to YouTube via API integration
End-to-end content pipeline for hands-free channel growth
steps: Input a topic or keyword for content generation
Generate the complete video script using AI models
Create a voiceover audio track from the script with TTS technology
Assemble the video by combining voiceover, script, and optional visual assets
Automatically upload the final video to YouTube using stored credentials
Receive and log confirmation of successful upload or handle errors
use_cases: YouTube creators seeking to automate video content production
Marketing teams needing to produce video content at scale
Businesses automating explainer or promotional video generation
Content creators wanting hands-free channel growth automation
Educational content producers streamlining video lesson creation

prompt_templates.name: script_generation
prompt_templates.template: Write a detailed YouTube video script on the topic: {script_topic}

prompt_templates.name: voiceover_generation
prompt_templates.template: Generate a natural-sounding voiceover audio for the following script: {generated_script}

prompt_templates.name: video_creation
prompt_templates.template: Create a video combining this voiceover audio and the following visual assets: {video_assets}

prompt_templates.name: upload_video
prompt_templates.template: Upload the video titled '{video_title}' to YouTube using the provided credentials.
